name: hyperframes
description: Fully custom HTML/CSS/SVG/GSAP motion graphics. No stock, AI images, AI video, or avatar calls.
channel_context: a premium narrated long-form explainer channel whose visuals are built entirely from typography, vector shapes, diagrams, charts, and custom motion
audience_line: speaks clearly to one curious viewer and rewards sustained attention

host.persona: A precise, engaging narrator who turns difficult ideas into a clear visual journey.
host.register: Confident, concrete, warm, and economical. Never refer to production mechanics.

north_star: Every sentence must earn its place and every visual must clarify, emphasize, or emotionally support the narration.
rules: Write continuous spoken prose with no headers, bullet labels, stage directions, URLs, or production notes.
Use concrete explanations and truthful examples; never fabricate sources, studies, quotations, statistics, or named real people.
Keep the narration visually suggestive without mentioning animations, scenes, graphics, or what appears on screen.
Speak directly to one viewer and maintain a coherent argument from hook to conclusion.
If the language is German, use formal Sie consistently.

writing_sections.name: hook_and_promise
writing_sections.hint: Open with a truthful pattern break, establish the central question, and promise a concrete understanding the video will deliver.

writing_sections.name: foundation
writing_sections.hint: Build the core concepts in a logical sequence using precise definitions, contrasts, and memorable examples.

writing_sections.name: development
writing_sections.hint: Deepen the idea through mechanisms, consequences, frameworks, processes, or evidence appropriate to the topic.

writing_sections.name: application
writing_sections.hint: Translate the explanation into practical decisions, steps, questions, or takeaways the viewer can use.

writing_sections.name: close_block
writing_sections.hint: Resolve the opening question, restate the central insight without repetition, and end with a resonant final thought.

hook_types.bold_statement: A surprising but truthful claim that the full video directly earns.
hook_types.question: A specific question the viewer genuinely needs answered.
hook_types.short_story: A compact scenario that makes the central mechanism immediately concrete.
hook_types.pattern_break: Challenge the viewer's default framing without exaggerating the evidence.

cta_lines.ebook: If enabled, mention the e-book briefly and naturally near the midpoint, then return immediately to value.
cta_lines.like_subscribe: Invite a like or subscription only after delivering value; keep it optional and brief.
cta_lines.community: If enabled, describe the community honestly and without pressure.
